title: Time decay estimates for localized perturbations around a helical state for the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert equation
summary: We study the dynamics of the Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert equation with the Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction. The equation admits a family of exact stationary solutions, referred to as helical states, which are periodic in one spatial variable and constant in the others. We investigate the dynamical stability of a helical state with respect to perturbations belonging to suitable Lebesgue and Sobolev spaces.
